user.title: Choose independent device features
user.description: Diagnostic configuration checks whether expected diagnostic entities are available and enabled; it does not determine device connectivity. Communication monitoring reads native last-contact times and warns after 24 hours; it does not require diagnostic entities to be enabled. Both include current and future Z-Wave JS and ZHA end devices. Nothing is enabled on a device without confirmation. Each feature has its own exclusions and can be turned off in integration options.

abort.already_configured: Garath Device Health is already configured.

configuration.title: Diagnostic configuration
configuration.description: Check whether expected diagnostic entities are available and enabled. This is a configuration check, not a connectivity test. Turning off this feature or excluding a device does not affect communication monitoring. Ignoring a configuration repair excludes the device only from this feature. Remove an exclusion to resume configuration checks.

communication.title: Communication monitoring
communication.description:
Warn after 24 hours without observed communication, using native protocol timestamps independently of diagnostic entity settings. Turning off this feature or excluding a device does not affect diagnostic configuration checks. Ignoring a communication repair excludes the device only from this feature.

Snoozed devices are listed with expiry times in your Home Assistant time zone. Select devices under Unsnooze devices to end their snoozes early; leave them unselected to keep snoozing. Unknown last-contact times and source warnings are not snoozed.

diagnostics.description: These diagnostic entities are disabled: {details}. This is a configuration recommendation, not evidence that the device is offline. Open the repair to enable the entities or stop configuration checks for this device. Ignoring this repair affects only configuration checks. Communication monitoring continues independently.

diagnostics_unavailable.title: Diagnostic configuration: entities unavailable for {device}
diagnostics_unavailable.description: These expected diagnostic entities are missing or blocked: {details}. Check the owning integration, finish device discovery, and check device/entity settings. This does not establish whether the device is communicating. Ignoring this repair stops only configuration checks for this device; communication monitoring continues independently.

last_seen_unknown.title: Communication monitoring: last contact unknown for {device}
last_seen_unknown.description: {details} Check the owning integration and allow the device to communicate normally, or wake it manually according to its instructions. This is not a claim that the device has failed. No stale-device determination is made until a timestamp is known. Ignoring this repair stops only communication monitoring for this device. Configuration checks are unaffected.

stale.title: Communication monitoring: no contact with {device} in 24 hours
stale.description:
Last observed communication (UTC): {details}.

Check power, batteries, range, and the owning integration. Some healthy battery devices communicate less frequently than daily. Open this repair to snooze the no-contact warning for 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days, or stop communication monitoring for this device. It clears automatically when communication resumes and does not ping or wake devices. Ignoring this repair stops only communication monitoring. Configuration checks are unaffected.

confirm.title: Communication monitoring for {device}
confirm.description:
Last observed communication (UTC): {details}.

Snooze this warning for 24 hours, 7 days, or 30 days without changing the last-contact time. Snoozes survive restarts and can be ended early in communication monitoring options. When a snooze expires, the next scan warns again only if communication is still overdue.

Stopping communication monitoring permanently, or using Home Assistant's Ignore action, affects only this feature. Diagnostic configuration checks are unaffected. Closing this dialog changes nothing.

configuration_unavailable.title: Diagnostic configuration: cannot check {device}
configuration_unavailable.description:
Cannot inspect diagnostic configuration: {details}.

Check the owning integration and Home Assistant logs. Existing configuration findings for this device are retained until the data can be trusted again. Other devices and communication monitoring continue independently. Ignoring this repair stops only configuration checks for this device.

communication_unavailable.title: Communication monitoring: cannot check {device}
communication_unavailable.description:
Cannot read a usable last-contact time: {details}.

Check the owning integration and Home Assistant logs. Existing communication findings for this device are retained until the data can be trusted again; this is not recovery. Other devices and configuration checks continue independently. Ignoring this repair stops only communication monitoring for this device.

configuration_source_unavailable.title: Diagnostic configuration checks paused for {protocol}
configuration_source_unavailable.description:
Cannot inspect the owning integration: {details}.

Check the integration connection and Home Assistant logs. Existing configuration findings for this protocol are retained. Communication monitoring and other protocols continue independently when their data is available. Ignoring this source warning does not exclude devices.

communication_source_unavailable.title: Communication monitoring paused for {protocol}
communication_source_unavailable.description:
Cannot read the owning integration: {details}.

Check the integration connection and Home Assistant logs. Existing communication findings for this protocol are retained. Configuration checks and other protocols continue independently when their data is available. Ignoring this source warning does not exclude devices.

source_unavailable.title: Device health monitoring paused for {protocol}
source_unavailable.description: Cannot read the owning integration: {details}. This legacy warning is replaced by feature-specific warnings on the next scan. Ignoring this source warning does not exclude devices.
